alts.quote: I definitely can't say anything specific, but what I can say is there is lots of really cool stuff coming next year that I'm very excited about.
alts.zh: 具體的我絕對不能講，但我可以說的是：明年有一堆很酷的東西要出來，我自己非常期待。

cards.pattern: I can't say anything specific, but what I can say is [可以講的那一層].
cards.quote: I definitely can't say anything specific, but what I can say is there is lots of really cool stuff coming next year that I'm very excited about.
cards.zh: 具體的我絕對不能講，但我可以說的是：明年有一堆很酷的東西要出來，我自己非常期待。
cards.why: 完整的「劃界＋交付」兩拍：先把不能講的部分講死（definitely），再換到可以講的抽象層。台灣人常只做第一拍，聽起來就像敷衍。
cards.pmNote: 對外談 roadmap 的安全解：可以講方向與情緒，不講品項與日期。
cards.episode: Building Anchor, selling to Spotify, and lessons learned | Maya Prohovnik (Spotify’s Head of Podcast Product)

alts.quote: So I can't speak to specific clients because I'm not allowed to talk about the work that we've done in large part, but that would be one example.
alts.zh: 我沒辦法談具體的客戶，因為我們做過的案子大部分不能講，但那會是一個例子。

alts.quote: Is it going to eliminate PMs next year? Probably not. Are the ratios between PMs and other teams going to shift over time? Yes. Are the skills required going to shift? Yes. Could they shift much faster than we all anticipate? Probably.
alts.zh: 明年就會取代 PM 嗎？大概不會。PM 跟其他團隊的比例會不會變？會。需要的技能會不會變？會。會不會變得比我們預期的快很多？很可能。

alts.quote: So those will be custom for anything. And I hate to use the word, it depends because I think whenever consultants say it depends, they're just throwing their hands up and saying, "I don't really know."
alts.zh: 這些每家都不一樣。我很不想講「看情況」，因為顧問一講「看情況」，通常就是兩手一攤說「我其實不知道」。

cards.quote: I don't understand what this is, and I'm not the right person for this role," and it turned out, nobody understood exactly what was going on.
cards.zh: 「我看不懂這是什麼，我也不是這個職位該找的人」——結果發現，根本沒有人真的搞懂在發生什麼事。
cards.why: 兩層坦白疊在一起：不懂＋我不適合。在英文職場這反而常是最快讓事情變清楚的一句，因為它逼出「其實大家都不懂」。
cards.episode: Building Wiz: the fastest-growing startup in history | Raaz Herzberg (CMO and VP Product Strategy)

alts.quote: I don't know exactly which occasion this person is referring to, but I know I've used that analogy a few times.
alts.zh: 我不確定這位聽眾指的是哪一次，但我知道我用過那個比喻好幾次。

alts.quote: Is this positioning good or not?" And the problem with B2B tech companies is, well, unless I'm your buyer, I'm not the right person to ask.
alts.zh: 「這個定位到底好不好？」B2B 科技公司的問題在於——除非我就是你的買家，不然我根本不是該問的那個人。

alts.quote: You should have 30 seconds for your play. Right? Don't ask me, I'm not a lawyer.
alts.zh: 應該有個三十秒的合理使用吧？別問我，我又不是律師。

cards.pattern: What I can tell you about [X] is [我的感受／立場].
cards.quote: But what I can tell you about what I'm feeling now is just an incredible sense of focus and urgency to deliver great products quickly.
cards.zh: 但我能告訴你的是我現在的感覺：一種強烈到不行的專注感和急迫感，想快點把好產品做出來。
cards.why: 事實不能講的時候，改交付「我的感受」——感受永遠是你有權發布的資訊，而且對方想知道的往往就是這個。
cards.episode: Inside Google's AI turnaround: The rise of AI Mode, strategy behind AI Overviews, and their vision for AI-powered search | Robby Stein (VP of Product, Google Search)

alts.quote: So I worked on Atlas for a bit. I don't work on it now. But a bit of the narrative here for me just to tell my story a bit was...
alts.zh: 我做過 Atlas 一陣子，現在沒在做了。不過就我自己的角度、講一下我的版本的話……

alts.quote: I'm not sure that it matches exactly to functions, but I can tell you what we're seeing more of, we need more of.
alts.zh: 我不確定這能不能剛好對到各個職能，但我可以告訴你我們看到什麼在變多、我們需要什麼變多。

alts.quote: Now, what I come back to, and I could be wrong, but what I come back to is we're talking through a medium, a mediated experience.
alts.zh: 我一直會回到的一點——我也可能是錯的——就是：我們是透過一個媒介在對話，一種被中介過的經驗。

cards.pattern: I have a new one that I can't share, but [指路到公開來源].
cards.quote: And I have a new one that I can't share, but we've written about it.
cards.zh: 我還有一個新的，不能講，但我們有寫過相關的東西。
cards.why: 不能講但給出可以自己去查的路徑，把界線變成線索。這比單純的 I can't share 多留了一道門。
cards.episode: The rituals of great teams | Shishir Mehrotra of Coda, YouTube, Microsoft

alts.quote: So I can't speak to specific clients because I'm not allowed to talk about the work that we've done in large part, but that would be one example.
alts.zh: 我沒辦法談具體的客戶，因為我們做過的案子大部分不能講，但那會是一個例子。

alts.quote: And then, we do have a list of cities that we're going to be rolling out in the coming years, but unfortunately, I can't share that list just as yet.
alts.zh: 我們確實有一份接下來幾年要開的城市清單，只是很抱歉，現在還不能公開。

alts.quote: I don't know if I have the recipe for this, but I can just maybe share a few of the things that come to mind.
alts.zh: 我不確定我有沒有一套配方，但我可以分享幾個當下想到的東西。

cards.pattern: We do have [X], but unfortunately I can't share it just as yet.
cards.quote: And then, we do have a list of cities that we're going to be rolling out in the coming years, but unfortunately, I can't share that list just as yet.
cards.zh: 我們確實有一份接下來幾年要開的城市清單，只是很抱歉，現在還不能公開。
cards.why: 先確認東西存在（we do have），再說不能給，最後用 just as yet 留下時間門。三拍下來，對方會覺得被尊重而不是被擋。
cards.episode: Product lessons from Waymo | Shweta Shrivastava (Waymo, Amazon, Cisco)

alts.quote: We're going to go off and make this two-year, five-year, whatever, 10-year vision even, and we're going to point us towards something." But the way that the technology is changing now, we don't know what's going to happen in two years.
alts.zh: 我們本來會去做那種兩年、五年甚至十年的願景，把大家指向某個方向，但以現在技術變化的速度，我們根本不知道兩年後會發生什麼事。

alts.quote: I definitely can't say anything specific, but what I can say is there is lots of really cool stuff coming next year that I'm very excited about.
alts.zh: 具體的我絕對不能講，但我可以說的是：明年有一堆很酷的東西要出來，我自己非常期待。

alts.quote: So if we can rebuild systems to let the agent be default useful, we'll start unlocking hockey sticks. Unfortunately, I don't think that's going to be binary.
alts.zh: 所以如果我們能把系統重建成讓 agent 預設就有用，成長曲線就會開始往上翹。可惜我不覺得這會是一刀切的事。

cards.pattern: I'll give you a very tactical example: when I joined [公司] in [年月], believe it or not, [反直覺的事實].
cards.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
cards.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。
cards.why: 例子開頭就給時間、公司、一個反直覺事實，聽的人三秒內就站好位置。believe it or not 是預告下一句會顛覆預期，讓人把耳朵打開。
cards.pmNote: 進新團隊先確認基礎埋點在不在；沒有數據就排不出優先順序。
cards.episode: Unorthodox frameworks for growing your product, career, and impact | Bangaly Kaba (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Instacart)

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very small example again, just from Webflow, this idea of keyboard shortcuts, feels small, but that is a piece that creates a lot of love from user base who are power users.
alts.zh: 我再給你一個很小的例子，就 Webflow 的鍵盤快捷鍵。聽起來很小，但那正是讓重度使用者愛上產品的關鍵之一。

alts.quote: For the longest time, and I'll give you actually a really concrete example, it was March 2020 and we were just watching COVID hit.
alts.zh: 有很長一段時間——我直接給你一個很具體的例子——那是 2020 年 3 月，我們就眼睜睜看著疫情打過來。

cards.pattern: I don't have a great example of that, but I can give you a tangentially related example of [X].
cards.quote: I don't have a great example of that, but I can give you a tangentially related example of a marketplace that I don't want to throw anyone under the bus.
cards.zh: 那個我沒有很好的例子，但我可以給你一個沾得上邊的：一個平台的故事，我不想害到任何人。
cards.why: 誠實說「我沒有正解」之後仍然交出東西，比硬掰一個貼題的例子有信用。tangentially related 是英文明講「這只沾到邊」的專用詞。
cards.episode: How marketplaces win: Liquidity, growth levers, quality, and more | Benjamin Lauzier (Lyft, Thumbtack, Reforge)

alts.quote: For the longest time, and I'll give you actually a really concrete example, it was March 2020 and we were just watching COVID hit.
alts.zh: 有很長一段時間——我直接給你一個很具體的例子——那是 2020 年 3 月，我們就眼睜睜看著疫情打過來。

alts.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
alts.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。

alts.quote: And one thing people make fun of me a lot for that I think is just a great example of extreme clarity is I never use bulleted lists because you can never refer to a bullet.
alts.zh: 有件事大家常笑我，但我覺得那正是「極度清楚」的最佳示範：我從來不用項目符號，因為你沒辦法指名某一個點。

cards.pattern: Just for context, [人] was [身分], which was the [熟悉的對照物] of [場域].
cards.quote: Just for context, Hermann was the creator of Acorn Computer, which was the Apple II of the UK back in the '70s.
cards.zh: 先講一下背景：Hermann 是 Acorn 電腦的創辦人，那家公司等於七〇年代英國的 Apple II。
cards.why: 介紹陌生人名時附一個對方一定認得的對照物。which was the X of Y 是英文最省力的補課工具，一句話補完聽眾缺的知識。
cards.episode: Father of the iPod and iPhone on building taste, judgment, and creativity in the AI era | Tony Fadell

alts.quote: I'd say that was the beginning of chapter two where it was we went from the company that could do no wrong to the company that could do no right, which was a big flip.
alts.zh: 我會說那就是第二章的開始——我們從「怎麼做都對」的公司，變成「怎麼做都錯」的公司，整個翻過來。

alts.quote: And after all of that, which clearly means they wanted it to work, they're like, "No, bye." What? Just on an emotional level, you got to go, "Wait a minute, that's terrible."
alts.zh: 經歷了這一整串——這明明代表他們很想讓它成功——結果他們說「不用了，掰」。蛤？光是情緒上你就該有反應：等一下，這超糟的。

alts.quote: Amazing product, GrowthBot, and it had just one teeny tiny small problem, which is it didn't work.
alts.zh: 超棒的產品，GrowthBot，只有一個小小小小的問題——它不能用。

cards.pattern: Maybe for context, we had built [故事開始前的狀態] where we were [在做的事].
cards.quote: So I guess maybe for context, we had built this very nascent publisher motion where we were going out and helping people publish their rituals.
cards.zh: 先補個背景好了：我們當時做出了一套還很初期的「發布者」機制，我們會去幫大家把自己的儀式發布出來。
cards.why: 用過去完成式（we had built）標記「這是故事開始前就存在的狀態」，聽的人自動知道正片還沒開始。
cards.episode: What sets great teams apart | Lane Shackleton (CPO of Coda)

alts.quote: They're going to be like, 'Oh, well, it sounds like you put in your best effort.' But if you walk away early, people are like, 'What?'
alts.zh: 他們會說：「喔，聽起來你已經盡力了。」但如果你提早收手，大家的反應會是：「蛤？」

alts.quote: If someone just came by and dropped the food on your plate on the table, and just left and never came with a bill, I'm like, okay, maybe I'm not going to recommend this to somebody else.
alts.zh: 如果有人把菜往你桌上一放就走了，連帳單都沒來過，那我大概不會把這家推薦給別人。

alts.quote: Instacart signed up for Stripe with a Gmail address and then Covid happened and they delivered critical food to everyone when people were reasonably not allowed to go to the grocery store easily. So you just don't know what the next Gmail address is going to do.
alts.zh: Instacart 當年是用一個 Gmail 信箱註冊 Stripe 的；後來疫情來了，在大家不太能去超市的時候，是他們把關鍵的食物送到每個人手上。所以你根本不知道，下一個 Gmail 信箱會做出什麼。

cards.pattern: For context, in [時間] we [事件], ending the year at [數字].
cards.quote: For context, in late 2016 we started gaining traction, ending the year at $3-4M in revenue.
cards.zh: 補一下背景：2016 年底我們開始有起色，那一年收在三到四百萬美金營收。
cards.why: For context 後面直接接時間跟數字，不接形容詞。背景要能被驗證才叫背景，否則只是鋪陳。
cards.episode: How to win in consumer subscription

alts.quote: I just started to feel this and it became like a pebble in my shoe. I started just to go through that process that you've gone through many times before of writing and distilling it, and that's where I came up with this hierarchy.
alts.zh: 我一直有這個感覺，它就像鞋子裡的一顆小石頭。後來我就照那個寫下來、把它蒸餾的過程走一遍，這個框架就是這樣長出來的。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

alts.quote: Just for context, Hermann was the creator of Acorn Computer, which was the Apple II of the UK back in the '70s.
alts.zh: 先講一下背景：Hermann 是 Acorn 電腦的創辦人，那家公司等於七〇年代英國的 Apple II。

cards.quote: I can tell you the short version, but I'll tell you the long version.
cards.zh: 我可以講短的版本，不過我要講長的版本。
cards.why: 明講兩種長度都存在，再宣布自己選長的——等於先取得對方同意再花他的時間，比默默講十分鐘禮貌得多。
cards.episode: How to fire people with grace, work through fear, and nurture innovation | Matt Mochary (CEO coach)

alts.quote: We need more, is the short version.
alts.zh: 我們需要更多——這就是簡短版。

alts.quote: The short version I think that works the best is almost like a U-curve where the X-axis is time and the Y-axis is level of involvement.
alts.zh: 最短的講法大概像一條 U 型曲線：橫軸是時間，縱軸是投入程度。

alts.quote: Now, you have to be careful, let's say, I'll give you an example where this can go wrong.
alts.zh: 不過這裡要小心，我給你一個會出事的例子。

cards.pattern: The short version is almost like [形狀] where the X-axis is [X] and the Y-axis is [Y].
cards.quote: The short version I think that works the best is almost like a U-curve where the X-axis is time and the Y-axis is level of involvement.
cards.zh: 最短的講法大概像一條 U 型曲線：橫軸是時間，縱軸是投入程度。
cards.why: 把抽象講法壓成一張圖，而且把兩個軸講清楚。聽的人腦中有了同一張圖，後面所有細節都掛得上去。
cards.pmNote: 講框架先給座標軸，再講曲線形狀，最後才講例外。
cards.episode: The 10 traits of great PMs, how AI will impact your product, and Slack’s product development process | Noah Weiss (Slack, Foursquare, Google)

alts.quote: The ambition can often feel like this sun, like the heat of the sun that's trying to warm everything up. And I think that, really, what the best, ambitious founders do is they focus that ambition like a laser beam on a small market, the thimble.
alts.zh: 野心常常像太陽，想把整片海都曬熱。但最厲害的創辦人，是把同樣的野心像雷射一樣打在一個很小的市場上。

alts.quote: So time becomes a convenient excuse for us where we say, 'Well, it's not me. It's just, I don't have time to work on it.'
alts.zh: 時間就變成一個很方便的藉口，我們會說：「不是我的問題，我只是沒時間做這件事。」

alts.quote: At Facebook in particular, I would find that every so often I would have to have what I called a Legos talk with someone where I would just see them start to ask these questions like, why are we hiring that person?
alts.zh: 特別是在 Facebook，我發現每隔一陣子就得跟某個人來一場我叫做「樂高談話」的對話——我會看到他們開始問：我們為什麼要招那個人？

cards.pattern: [結論], is the short version.
cards.quote: We need more, is the short version.
cards.zh: 我們需要更多——這就是簡短版。
cards.why: 把結論放前面，再回頭標記「這是精簡版」。倒裝讓句子聽起來果斷，同時暗示還有細節可以追問。
cards.episode: Unorthodox PM wisdom: Automating user insights, unselling job candidates, logging every decision, more | Kevin Yien (Stripe, Square, Mutiny)

alts.quote: I can tell you the short version, but I'll tell you the long version.
alts.zh: 我可以講短的版本，不過我要講長的版本。

alts.quote: The short version I think that works the best is almost like a U-curve where the X-axis is time and the Y-axis is level of involvement.
alts.zh: 最短的講法大概像一條 U 型曲線：橫軸是時間，縱軸是投入程度。

alts.quote: You've started this company, it's been super successful, and then suddenly your employees don't want to wear your T-shirt anymore.
alts.zh: 你創了這家公司，它一路很成功，然後突然間，員工不想再穿你們公司的 T-shirt 了。

cards.pattern: For the longest time — and I'll give you a really concrete example — it was [年月] and we were [當時在做的事].
cards.quote: For the longest time, and I'll give you actually a really concrete example, it was March 2020 and we were just watching COVID hit.
cards.zh: 有很長一段時間——我直接給你一個很具體的例子——那是 2020 年 3 月，我們就眼睜睜看著疫情打過來。
cards.why: 把「我要舉例了」塞成插入句，不打斷原本的句子。這是英文口語很高階的一手：宣告與內容同時進行，節奏不掉。
cards.episode: LinkedIn’s product evolution and the art of building complex systems | Hari Srinivasan (LinkedIn)

alts.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
alts.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

cards.pattern: I'll give you a bit of a different one, because this one is harder to spot.
cards.quote: I think I'll give you a bit of a different one because I think this one is harder to spot and I think that's really interesting.
cards.zh: 我想給你一個不太一樣的例子，因為這個比較難被看出來，我覺得那才有意思。
cards.why: 舉例前先講「為什麼挑這個」。挑選理由本身就是觀點，能把一個普通例子變成有立場的例子。
cards.episode: Lessons from Atlassian: Launching new products, getting buy-in, and staying ahead of the competition | Megan Cook (head of product, Jira)

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

alts.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
alts.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。

alts.quote: So think of these prototypes as these concept cars that really drive inspiration and potentially give you some small nuggets that you can run with.
alts.zh: 所以把這些原型想成概念車：它們的作用是帶來靈感，順便給你一些可以真的拿去用的小片段。

cards.pattern: You have to be careful — I'll give you an example where this can go wrong.
cards.quote: Now, you have to be careful, let's say, I'll give you an example where this can go wrong.
cards.zh: 不過這裡要小心，我給你一個會出事的例子。
cards.why: 舉的是反例。先講完好處再主動給失敗案例，整段建議聽起來就像是自己用過的，而不是背下來的。
cards.episode: Hard truths about building in the AI era | Keith Rabois (Khosla Ventures)

alts.quote: I'll give you a little toy example.
alts.zh: 我給你一個小小的玩具級例子。

alts.quote: I'd say that was the beginning of chapter two where it was we went from the company that could do no wrong to the company that could do no right, which was a big flip.
alts.zh: 我會說那就是第二章的開始——我們從「怎麼做都對」的公司，變成「怎麼做都錯」的公司，整個翻過來。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

cards.pattern: I hate [X], I think it is a terrible [類別] … and I'll give you an example.
cards.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
cards.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。
cards.why: 極端立場連續堆疊之後，最後一句 and I'll give you an example 把整段從情緒拉回可檢驗。沒有那一句，前面全是叫囂。
cards.pmNote: 敢公開否定主流框架的人要立刻附例子，否則只會被當成挑釁。
cards.episode: Hot takes and techno-optimism from tech’s top power couple | Sriram and Aarthi

alts.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
alts.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。

alts.quote: You kind of come up thinking you're the protagonist. You can be the protagonist in your life, but in the story of your work of a company, you are probably not the protagonist.
alts.zh: 你一路長大都以為自己是主角。你在自己的人生裡可以是主角，但在公司這個故事裡，你多半不是主角。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

cards.pattern: I'll give you an example from my own career — not that I'm comparing myself to [大人物] — but [接續].
cards.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
cards.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。
cards.why: 舉自己當例子時先擋掉「自抬身價」的解讀。not that I'm comparing myself to… 是英文專門用來拆這顆地雷的句型。
cards.episode: Radical Candor: From theory to practice with author Kim Scott

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

alts.quote: For the longest time, and I'll give you actually a really concrete example, it was March 2020 and we were just watching COVID hit.
alts.zh: 有很長一段時間——我直接給你一個很具體的例子——那是 2020 年 3 月，我們就眼睜睜看著疫情打過來。

alts.quote: And one thing people make fun of me a lot for that I think is just a great example of extreme clarity is I never use bulleted lists because you can never refer to a bullet.
alts.zh: 有件事大家常笑我，但我覺得那正是「極度清楚」的最佳示範：我從來不用項目符號，因為你沒辦法指名某一個點。

cards.pattern: This is me paraphrasing, so give me some license, but [某人] is the source.
cards.quote: And at a high level, and this is me paraphrasing, so give me some license, but he's the source.
cards.zh: 大方向上——這是我自己轉述的，講得不精準請見諒——但源頭是他。
cards.why: 轉述別人觀點時同時標記兩件事：這不是原話、功勞是誰的。give me some license 等於先申請免責，讓你可以講得順而不必背原文。
cards.episode: How to become a category pirate | Christopher Lochhead (author of Play Bigger, Niche Down, Category Pirates, more)

alts.quote: So think of these prototypes as these concept cars that really drive inspiration and potentially give you some small nuggets that you can run with.
alts.zh: 所以把這些原型想成概念車：它們的作用是帶來靈感，順便給你一些可以真的拿去用的小片段。

alts.quote: To burn that black thread, there has to be a source of power, the sun. There has to be a focus. And it has to be a target that can be affected.
alts.zh: 要燒穿那根黑線，必須有能量來源，也就是太陽。必須有聚焦。而且必須是一個真的會被影響的目標。

alts.quote: And so you go from this moment of the hard high cost of sales, pounding the pavement, to getting a list on a silver platter of restaurants to onboard. And that's that feeling of tipping, where all of a sudden something goes from being really freaking hard to so much easier.
alts.zh: 你會從那種一家一家敲門、成本超高的銷售，變成人家直接把一份餐廳名單端到你面前。那就是市場翻轉的感覺——某件事忽然從超級難變成輕鬆很多。

cards.quote: Let me tell you one not very happy story.
cards.zh: 我來講一個不太愉快的故事。
cards.why: 先幫故事貼上情緒標籤，聽的人就不會用錯的期待去聽。英文說故事很常先報結局的色調，再講過程。
cards.episode: How to build a company that withstands any era | Eric Ries, Lean Startup author

alts.quote: A good story is not about facts. It's about creating emotional engagement. It's about creating the sense that the listener would like to be part of this story.
alts.zh: 好故事不是關於事實。它是關於製造情緒上的連結。是讓聽的人覺得自己想要成為這個故事的一部分。

alts.quote: And the story is like there's a frog at the bottom of the well. He looks up every night and he sees the world and he imagines he knows everything about the world.
alts.zh: 故事是這樣：有一隻青蛙住在井底。牠每天晚上抬頭看那一小塊天，就以為自己什麼都懂了。

alts.quote: If you're trying to do it, the best way to tell a story about something that you want people to understand is to do what I call speaking with adjacency, which means we're not going to match content to content.
alts.zh: 如果你想讓別人理解某件事，最好的說故事方式是我所謂的「用鄰近性說話」——意思是我們不會拿內容去對內容。

cards.pattern: I'll give you a very small example — [例子] — feels small, but that is what creates [大效果].
cards.quote: I'll give you a very small example again, just from Webflow, this idea of keyboard shortcuts, feels small, but that is a piece that creates a lot of love from user base who are power users.
cards.zh: 我再給你一個很小的例子，就 Webflow 的鍵盤快捷鍵。聽起來很小，但那正是讓重度使用者愛上產品的關鍵之一。
cards.why: 自己先承認例子很小（feels small），再用 but 把份量拉起來。先自貶再翻轉，比一開始就宣稱重要更有說服力。
cards.pmNote: 快捷鍵這類「小功能」對重度使用者是留存槓桿，不要用整體使用率去評估它。
cards.episode: Building minimum lovable products, stories from WeWork and Airbnb, and thriving as a PM | Jiaona Zhang (Webflow, WeWork, Airbnb, Dropbox)

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

alts.quote: For the longest time, and I'll give you actually a really concrete example, it was March 2020 and we were just watching COVID hit.
alts.zh: 有很長一段時間——我直接給你一個很具體的例子——那是 2020 年 3 月，我們就眼睜睜看著疫情打過來。

cards.quote: I'll give you a little toy example.
cards.zh: 我給你一個小小的玩具級例子。
cards.why: toy example 明確宣告「這個例子被簡化過，不要拿去套現實」。先降低對方對嚴謹度的期待，你就能講得很快。
cards.episode: He saved OpenAI, invented the “Like” button, and built Google Maps: Bret Taylor on the future of careers, coding, agents, and more

alts.quote: Now, you have to be careful, let's say, I'll give you an example where this can go wrong.
alts.zh: 不過這裡要小心，我給你一個會出事的例子。

alts.quote: I'll give you a very tactical example is when I joined Instagram in January 2016, believe it or not, the onboarding, the sign-up flow at Instagram had literally no logging to it.
alts.zh: 我給你一個很具體的例子：我 2016 年 1 月進 Instagram 的時候，說出來你可能不信，它的註冊流程完全沒有埋任何追蹤。

alts.quote: I hate Jobs-to-be-Done, I think it is a terrible framework, I think no successful company has ever been built on top of JTBD and if you pick JTBD, you're probably doomed and I'll give you an example.
alts.zh: 我討厭 Jobs-to-be-Done，我覺得那是個爛框架，沒有一家成功公司是靠 JTBD 建起來的；你要是選了它，大概就完了——我給你一個例子。

cards.pattern: [X] is a great example of [概念] because [為什麼它算].
cards.quote: An RFP is a great example of overfitting in the world of procurement because it tells you nothing about the quality of software behind it.
cards.zh: RFP 就是採購世界裡「過度擬合」的最佳例子，因為它完全講不出背後那套軟體的品質好不好。
cards.why: a great example of 後面一定要接 because，否則只是貼標籤。那個 because 才是把例子跟抽象概念鎖在一起的螺絲。
cards.episode: Tobi Lutke

alts.quote: And one thing people make fun of me a lot for that I think is just a great example of extreme clarity is I never use bulleted lists because you can never refer to a bullet.
alts.zh: 有件事大家常笑我，但我覺得那正是「極度清楚」的最佳示範：我從來不用項目符號，因為你沒辦法指名某一個點。

alts.quote: Over the course of our life, because of all these little situations that happen, we start getting bugs in the software and we're not really upgrading our software.
alts.zh: 在人生的過程裡，因為發生了各種小事，我們的軟體開始長 bug，而我們也沒有真的在更新它。

alts.quote: As a great example of this, when we wrote the sales plans for this year at Vercel, the AI cloud did not exist.
alts.zh: 舉一個很好的例子：我們今年在 Vercel 寫銷售計畫的時候，「AI cloud」這個東西還不存在。

cards.pattern: One thing people make fun of me for — which I think is a great example of [價值] — is [我的怪癖].
cards.quote: And one thing people make fun of me a lot for that I think is just a great example of extreme clarity is I never use bulleted lists because you can never refer to a bullet.
cards.zh: 有件事大家常笑我，但我覺得那正是「極度清楚」的最佳示範：我從來不用項目符號，因為你沒辦法指名某一個點。
cards.why: 拿別人笑你的地方當例子，先解除了對方的抵抗。後面那個 because 給出可操作的理由，怪癖就變成方法。
cards.pmNote: 文件用編號不用項目符號，開會才有辦法說「第三點」。
cards.episode: Meta’s Head of Product (and 29th employee) on working with Mark Zuckerberg, early growth tactics, why PMs are like conductors, and more | Naomi Gleit

alts.quote: We call it the bow and arrow technique because we think you can only remember one thing out of a talk and that it's very powerful to go through that framework or that kind of thinking when you're building a talk.
alts.zh: 我們把它叫做「弓與箭技巧」，因為我們認為一場演講聽眾只記得住一件事，而在準備演講時走過這套思考非常有效。

alts.quote: I'll give you an example of that from my own career, not that I am comparing myself to Steve Jobs, I think I'm a much gentler person, but sometimes I develop relationships with people.
alts.zh: 我給你一個我自己職涯裡的例子，不是說我在跟賈伯斯相提並論，我覺得我溫和多了，但我有時候確實會跟人發展出那種關係。

alts.quote: It doesn't matter if you think Bloomberg or Trump should be president. Do you think everyone should have access to great education? Most people would say yes.
alts.zh: 你覺得該讓 Bloomberg 還是 Trump 當總統，都無所謂。你覺得每個人都該有機會受好的教育嗎？大多數人會說會。

cards.pattern: As a great example of this, when we [做某事] at [時間], [現在理所當然的東西] did not exist.
cards.quote: As a great example of this, when we wrote the sales plans for this year at Vercel, the AI cloud did not exist.
cards.zh: 舉一個很好的例子：我們今年在 Vercel 寫銷售計畫的時候，「AI cloud」這個東西還不存在。
cards.why: 用「那時候還沒有 X」來量化變化速度，比講「變很快」有力。聽的人會自己去算那段時間有多短。
cards.pmNote: 年度計畫的失效速度本身就是一個要規劃的變數。
cards.episode: What world-class GTM looks like in 2026 | Jeanne DeWitt Grosser (Vercel, Stripe, Google)

alts.quote: An RFP is a great example of overfitting in the world of procurement because it tells you nothing about the quality of software behind it.
alts.zh: RFP 就是採購世界裡「過度擬合」的最佳例子，因為它完全講不出背後那套軟體的品質好不好。

alts.quote: I don't have a great example of that, but I can give you a tangentially related example of a marketplace that I don't want to throw anyone under the bus.
alts.zh: 那個我沒有很好的例子，但我可以給你一個沾得上邊的：一個平台的故事，我不想害到任何人。

alts.quote: And one thing people make fun of me a lot for that I think is just a great example of extreme clarity is I never use bulleted lists because you can never refer to a bullet.
alts.zh: 有件事大家常笑我，但我覺得那正是「極度清楚」的最佳示範：我從來不用項目符號，因為你沒辦法指名某一個點。

cards.pattern: You have [新狀態], and you can [新能力], and you can [新能力].
cards.quote: You have written down the logic of the software, and you can edit that at a high level, and you can point at that.
cards.zh: 你等於把軟體的邏輯寫下來了，你可以在很高的層次上編輯它，而且你可以直接指著它。
cards.why: 講願景用第二人稱現在式，把還沒發生的事描述成使用者已經在做的動作。三個 you can 疊上去，畫面就成形了。
cards.episode: The rise of Cursor: The $300M ARR AI tool that engineers can’t stop using | Michael Truell (co-founder and CEO)

alts.quote: And what blew my mind is, it's not priced in, to any of these companies out there. And it's not reflected in the org charts of all the software companies in the world right now. That is going to completely change.
alts.zh: 最讓我震驚的是：這件事根本還沒被 price in。它完全沒有反映在現在全世界軟體公司的組織圖上。而這會徹底改變。

alts.quote: So I guess there's two ways of planning. The way that you can plan is you can dream of what is the perfect vision of the future, what future do you want to exist in, what would you like the world to look like?
alts.zh: 我覺得規劃大概分兩種。一種是你去夢想那個最完美的未來——你想活在什麼樣的未來裡？你希望這個世界長什麼樣子？

alts.quote: And he would say, you have to aim for Chartres. You have to make something that is better than that. That should be your goal, not to just turn in something that's what you feel is good enough.
alts.zh: 他會說：你要對準夏特大教堂。你要做出比它更好的東西。那才是你的目標，而不是交出一個你自己覺得「還可以」的作品。
